panels.title: PV: Prognose (6 h vorher) vs. Ist [Wh/h]

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.hour AS time, a.value AS "Ist",
  (SELECT sum(f.value) FROM eos_forecast f
    WHERE f.series = 'pvforecast_ac_energy_wh' AND f.target_time >= a.hour AND f.target_time < a.hour + interval '1 hour'
      AND f.issued_at = (SELECT max(f2.issued_at) FROM eos_forecast f2 WHERE f2.series = 'pvforecast_ac_energy_wh'
                         AND f2.target_time = f.target_time AND f2.issued_at <= a.hour - interval '6 hours')) AS "Prognose 6 h"
FROM eos_actual a WHERE a.series = 'pv_wh' AND $__timeFilter(a.hour) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last: Prognose (1 h vorher) vs. Ist [Wh/h]

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.hour AS time, a.value AS "Ist",
  (SELECT sum(f.value) FROM eos_forecast f
    WHERE f.series = 'loadforecast_energy_wh' AND f.target_time >= a.hour AND f.target_time < a.hour + interval '1 hour'
      AND f.issued_at = (SELECT max(f2.issued_at) FROM eos_forecast f2 WHERE f2.series = 'loadforecast_energy_wh'
                         AND f2.target_time = f.target_time AND f2.issued_at <= a.hour - interval '1 hour')) AS "Prognose 1 h"
FROM eos_actual a WHERE a.series = 'base_load_wh' AND $__timeFilter(a.hour) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prognosefehler MAE je Reihe und Vorlauf

targets.rawSql:
SELECT evaluated_at AS time, name || ' ' || lead_h || ' h' AS metric, mae AS value
FROM eos_accuracy WHERE $__timeFilter(evaluated_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bias (Prognose - Ist) je Reihe und Vorlauf

targets.rawSql:
SELECT evaluated_at AS time, name || ' ' || lead_h || ' h' AS metric, bias AS value
FROM eos_accuracy WHERE $__timeFilter(evaluated_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Geplante Ersparnis ggü. Eigenverbrauch [EUR je Lauf]

targets.rawSql:
SELECT issued_at AS time, algorithm AS metric, (meta->>'saving_vs_baseline_amt')::float AS value
FROM eos_run WHERE $__timeFilter(issued_at) AND meta ? 'saving_vs_baseline_amt' ORDER BY 1

SELECT issued_at AS time, algorithm AS metric, duration_s AS value
FROM eos_run WHERE $__timeFilter(issued_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Raumtemperatur: Plan (1 h vorher) vs. Ist [°C]

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.hour AS time, a.value AS "Ist",
  (SELECT avg(p.value) FROM eos_plan p
    WHERE p.series = 'wbb12_room_temperature_c' AND p.target_time >= a.hour AND p.target_time < a.hour + interval '1 hour'
      AND p.issued_at = (SELECT max(p2.issued_at) FROM eos_plan p2 WHERE p2.series = 'wbb12_room_temperature_c'
                         AND p2.target_time = p.target_time AND p2.issued_at <= a.hour - interval '1 hour')) AS "Plan 1 h"
FROM eos_actual a WHERE a.series = 'room_c' AND $__timeFilter(a.hour) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Netzbezug: Plan (1 h vorher) vs. Ist [Wh/h]

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.hour AS time, a.value AS "Ist",
  (SELECT sum(p.value) FROM eos_plan p
    WHERE p.series = 'grid_consumption_energy_wh' AND p.target_time >= a.hour AND p.target_time < a.hour + interval '1 hour'
      AND p.issued_at = (SELECT max(p2.issued_at) FROM eos_plan p2 WHERE p2.series = 'grid_consumption_energy_wh'
                         AND p2.target_time = p.target_time AND p2.issued_at <= a.hour - interval '1 hour')) AS "Plan 1 h"
FROM eos_actual a WHERE a.series = 'grid_import_wh' AND $__timeFilter(a.hour) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Realisierte Netzkosten je Tag und Algorithmus (A/B)

targets.rawSql:
WITH hours AS (
    SELECT a.hour,
           sum(CASE WHEN a.series = 'grid_import_wh' THEN a.value END) AS imp,
           sum(CASE WHEN a.series = 'grid_export_wh' THEN a.value END) AS exp
    FROM eos_actual a
    WHERE a.series IN ('grid_import_wh', 'grid_export_wh')
      AND a.hour >= $__timeFrom() AND a.hour < $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY a.hour
), priced AS (
    SELECT h.hour, h.imp, h.exp,
           (SELECT avg(f.value) FROM eos_forecast f
             WHERE f.series = 'elec_price_amt_kwh'
               AND f.target_time >= h.hour AND f.target_time < h.hour + interval '1 hour'
               AND f.issued_at = (SELECT max(f2.issued_at) FROM eos_forecast f2
                                  WHERE f2.series = 'elec_price_amt_kwh'
                                    AND f2.target_time = f.target_time
                                    AND f2.issued_at <= h.hour)) AS price,
           (SELECT avg(f.value) FROM eos_forecast f
             WHERE f.series = 'feed_in_tariff_amt_kwh'
               AND f.target_time >= h.hour AND f.target_time < h.hour + interval '1 hour'
               AND f.issued_at = (SELECT max(f2.issued_at) FROM eos_forecast f2
                                  WHERE f2.series = 'feed_in_tariff_amt_kwh'
                                    AND f2.target_time = f.target_time
                                    AND f2.issued_at <= h.hour)) AS tariff
    FROM hours h
), algo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (day) day, algorithm FROM (
        SELECT (issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AS day, algorithm, count(*) AS n
        FROM eos_run WHERE issued_at >= $__timeFrom() AND issued_at < $__timeTo()
        GROUP BY 1, 2) c
    ORDER BY day, n DESC
)
SELECT (p.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AS day,
       algo.algorithm,
       count(*) AS hours,
       sum(coalesce(p.imp, 0)) AS import_wh,
       sum(coalesce(p.exp, 0)) AS export_wh,
       sum(coalesce(p.imp, 0) / 1000 * coalesce(p.price, 0)
           - coalesce(p.exp, 0) / 1000 * coalesce(p.tariff, 0)) AS net_amt
FROM priced p
LEFT JOIN algo ON algo.day = (p.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
